item.title: Mary Fowler's Man City boost with big WSL win over Arsenal
item.description: Mary Fowler's landmark 100th game for Manchester City is a bright spot for the beleaguered club, with a big win over Arsenal keeping them with a perfect record on top of the WSL. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 19yo driver allegedly rammed rideshare with two people inside
item.description: A 19-year-old driver who allegedly rammed a rideshare vehicle carrying two passengers has been arrested in Adelaide's north, with SA Police also responding to several other crashes, including one in which a 53-year-old man was killed. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Don't drop it': Star's nervous moment as Roosters celebrate in Bondi
item.description: Grand final hero Mark Nawaqanitawase lifts the Provan-Summons trophy to adoring fans as his coach describes the Roosters star as "extraordinary". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Teen pedestrian critical after being hit by e-bike near Wollongong
item.description: Police allege an e-bike rider returned an alcohol reading more than twice the driving limit and positive tests for cocaine and meth after a crash critically injured a 16-year-old girl near Wollongong. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Kelly Fuller

item.title: US marine arrested on suspicion of murder and robbery in Japan's Okinawa
item.description: Japanese police arrest a 20-year-old US marine in the Okinawa prefecture on suspicion of robbing and murdering a local woman. Publicado también por: NPR - World, BBC News - World. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: AFL trade period officially opens as stars eye blockbuster moves
item.description: The AFL trade period officially opens as stars like Zak Butters, Zach Merrett and Ben King chase blockbuster moves. Follow all the news and debate live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Dean Bilton

item.title: What to look for during the AFL trade period
item.description: As one footy season ends, the next one begins almost immediately with free agency, trade and the draft period. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Cody Atkinson and Sean Lawson

item.title: NT government scrambles for Batchelor dialysis options ahead of YiSSA closure
item.description: The government has previously said dialysis patients would not be moved to Batchelor, 100 kilometres from Darwin, when they are evicted from the YiSSA accommodation facility in the NT capital. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Felicity James

item.title: Opal miners, whip crackers and teddy makers eye Olympic stage
item.description: In the most remote parts of the state, communities are hoping they too can have a crack at a piece of Queensland's Olympic pie. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lachlan Ford

item.title: Former foster child's NDIS plan didn't prepare him for adulthood
item.description: Coby spends his days at his computer. His experiences with Child Safety Services while in foster care have left him anxious and distrustful, and his NDIS plan failed to prepare him for life as an adult. Then they tried to move him into public housing. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Adam Holmes

item.title: Dwindling volunteer numbers put seafarers' rights at risk, charity says
item.description: Without volunteers at regional ports, seafarers would not be able to set foot on Australian soil between journeys. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Queensland mother seeks to force inquest into daughter's 2023 Kakadu death
item.description: Jessica Stephens's mother Karon Evans has applied for court orders that would force the Northern Territory coroner to hold an inquest into her death in Kakadu National Park after being discharged from Royal Darwin Hospital in 2023. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jason Walls

item.title: Residents fear there is no stopping $32b hyperscale data centre
item.description: Anthropic has already signed a deal to use a portion of the facility earmarked for the Western Downs, but it has not actually been approved yet Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Jane Doe threatened in Cornell University rape case, lawyer says
item.description: People have threatened to harm the woman identified as Jane Doe in the Cornell University case unless she withdraws her lawsuit, her lawyer says. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Labuschagne set for Test after first ton in 11 months
item.description: Marnus Labuschagne makes his case to keep the number three spot in Friday's first Test against South Africa, with a timely century in a warm-up match. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Roads, renewables and state taxes spark debate at Ripon election forum
item.description: Renewable energy transmission lines, the emergency services levy and roads were contentious topics at a candidates' forum in the marginal regional Victorian electorate of Ripon on Sunday. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Eden Hynninen

item.title: Live: Chris Bowen won't detail final cost of pre-COP meeting
item.description: Climate Change Minister Chris Bowen hasn't detailed the final cost of the pre-COP Pacific meeting starting today. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Joshua Boscaini

item.title: Live: Wall Street closes higher after disappointing jobs report, ASX set to gain
item.description: Wall Street's key indices gained as rate rise expectations were wound back on soft jobs data. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Letts

item.title: Two pedestrians killed after being hit by car
item.description: Two men aged 70 and 55 have died after being hit by an SUV at Tura Beach, north of Merimbula, with the driver taken to hospital for mandatory testing. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Adriane Reardon

item.title: Showers bring 'awkward' end to long weekend across south-east Queensland
item.description: Rain and possible isolated severe storms are forecast for south-east Queensland as school resumes on Tuesday, while the northern coast stays mostly fine and the west remains hot. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Former Bachelor star Sam Wood facing domestic violence charges
item.description: Fitness influencer and former Bachelor contestant Sam Wood is due to face court this morning on several domestic violence charges following his arrest in Noosa on the weekend. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Owen Jacques

item.title: Almost half of Queenslanders don't believe police are honest, report finds
item.description: Data in the QPS's annual report has revealed the service failed to meet public integrity benchmarks including public trust, police honesty, and fairness by as much as 22 per cent. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Ned Hammond

item.title: There are only six of these trees left in the wild. Conservationists are cloning them
item.description: The trees are estimated to be between 3,000 and 6,000 years old but they have no future without intervention. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lish Fejer

item.title: Short-stay operators have mixed reactions to SA's register proposal
item.description: The scheme is still being shaped but some operators are raising concerns about security and giving local governments control over land use and deciding rates. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Aiden McNamara

item.title: 3 million face masks could be used to build 1 km road, Australian study finds
item.description: Engineers at RMIT University have discovered a groundbreaking method to recycle single-use face masks by integrating them into road construction. By blending shredded masks with recycled concrete aggregate, the researchers aim to enhance road materials while tackling the problem of mask waste. Their findings suggest that approximately 3 million masks could be utilized in constructing a one-kilometre, two-lane road. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Push for review for victim-survivors after prosecution change to EMDR
item.description: A Sunshine Coast woman whose allegations of child abuse were not investigated by police because she had received a recommended trauma therapy is pushing for a review into how many alleged victim-survivors have faced the same barrier to justice. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emily Baker

item.title: De Minaur fights back to reach China Open semis
item.description: Australia's Alex de Minaur pulls out a comeback win to reach the semifinals of the China Open in Beijing. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Fire destroys prestige car workshop in Melbourne's north-west
item.description: Firefighters have battled for more than two hours to control a blaze inside a car workshop in Airport West early this morning. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Farmer fined $60k for clearing native vegetation north of Adelaide
item.description: A 73-year-old farmer is fined $60,000 for clearing more than 250 hectares of native vegetation at a property at Port Wakefield. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia's oldest man celebrates 113th birthday with ride in vintage car
item.description: Australia's oldest man, Ken Weeks, and the world's oldest man, Joao Marinho Neto, share the same birthday and exchanged best wishes for the first time this year. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
